title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E09 — Bikefest
One hundred thousand roaring motorcycles roll into the Lake of the Ozarks region for the seminal event of the season; the Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must team up with the State Troopers.

title: Ozark Law
description:
S01 E02 — Aquapalooza!
Crowds flock to the Lake of the Ozarks for the annual Aquapalooza Music Festival during the day; at night, Detective Sgt. Mark Kordula and Chief Boren face underage drinkers using fake IDs to enter bars.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E04 — Episode 4
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; troopers chase a suspect off-road, through wrong-way highway traffic and across busy city streets, as dangerous debris falls from the back of his stolen truck.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E02 — Episode 2
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; after a high-speed chase ends with a crash on the highway, the suspect shocks officers by attacking one of the accident victims with a knife.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E01 — Episode 1
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; a suspect in a box truck causes multiple collisions on the highway before engaging officers in an airport shootout; a K-9 officer chases down a fugitive wanted for aggravated battery.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E03 — Episode 3
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; officers chase a stolen car with the victim's one-year-old boy still in the back seat; an armed suspect who claims to be "CIA" flees from a traffic stop and rams a police cruiser.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E09 — Episode 9
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; a man fleeing from state troopers jumps off Florida's 7-Mile Bridge into the ocean below; a wanted man smashes into multiple cars while trying to flee from police at a gas station.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E05 — Episode 5
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; a getaway driver smashes into three police cruisers and a bystander's SUV while leading officers on a high-speed, parking lot chase.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E20 — Episode 20
A man wanted for assault pulls a gun on a police officer and then steals his cruiser; a high-speed chase comes to an end when the suspect's car bursts into flames; a wanted man fleeing from officers appears to be heading for the Canadian border.

title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
description:
S02 E13 — Episode 13
Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run; multiple agencies face off against an armed fugitive who's abducted his daughter; a driver who crashed his car while fleeing from police gets tased; fugitives in a stolen car survive stop sticks.

title: Court Cam
description:
S08 E15 — Episode 15
A look at some of the wild courtroom moments; a man accused of indecent exposure slams his head against a courtroom desk during questioning; a father takes his 19-year-old daughter to court over back rent; a woman in court for a bond violation.

title: Court Cam
description:
Top 5 Accused Killers 3
Some of the wildest courtroom moments, featuring accused killers; a 28-year-old man who killed his parents for no longer financially supporting him; a woman who kills her husband in their bed; a man who murders his wife, then calls the authorities.

title: Court Cam
description:
Top Five: Strangest Moments

title: Court Cam
description:

description:

description:
